blurb: Guests can experience the Maid of the Mist boat tour to see the falls up close, enjoy the Above the Roar VR experience for a virtual aerial and underwater view of the falls, take guided walking tours highlighting the falls and park history, and visit the Aquarium of Niagara to see aquatic animals and local species. The park offers accessible trails and attractions. The park is open year-round, with attractions having seasonal schedules.
